description: Two qmf-data modules compute an fp1 fingerprint themselves (hand-rolled hashlib.sha256 + "fp1:sha256:" string) instead of calling qmf-core's single fp1 implementation, violating the CT-05/DEC-0108 rule that no package computes a fingerprint except by calling qmf-core.
expected: No package outside qmf-core computes an fp1 fingerprint; every fingerprint routes through qmf.core (canonical_bytes/fingerprint / the single sha256 recipe), so a recipe or canonicalisation change applies everywhere and old fingerprints never fork.
observed: packages/qmf-data/src/qmf/data/backup.py (_fp1_of, lines 932-935) and packages/qmf-data/src/qmf/data/store/backup_input.py (_fp1 lines 70-72 with hashlib.sha256 at line 197) each run hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() and emit "fp1:sha256:{digest}" directly, duplicating qmf-core's private _fingerprint_of_bytes recipe.
